A variety of '''beetle''' that had adapted to feed on [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] radiation infested the [[Loronar shipyards]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The [[Species/Legends|species]]' [[Queen/Legends|queens]] grew to massive size.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Bioanalysis|Hyperdrive Nests}}</ref>
